missile_rating: Large missile = Level D per general rule R-004; drawing states LMI/SMI (sheet 1)
value_semantics: Design pressures are allowable (ASD) PSF, +/- unless stated. Size limits are maxima. null = N/A on the drawing (not permitted).

Lock 2.active: Kawneer 1686 panic device system with Kawneer's cylinder (actuates top & bottom rods)

Lock 3.active: Falcon HH 1690 panic device system with Schlage's cylinder (actuates top & bottom rods)

Lock 4.active: Von Duprin HH-KAW-9947 panic device system with Schlage's cylinder (actuates top & bottom rods)

glass.build: 1" O.A. laminated IG: 1/4" tempered / 1/2" aluminum spacer / 1/8" HS / 0.090" SentryGlas (Kuraray) / 1/8" HS

notes: FW = frame width, FH = frame height; D.O.(W) = FW - deduction, D.O.(H) = FH - deduction.
For double doors divide D.O.(W) by two for D.L.O. width.
Door leaf clearance: 1/8" at head and jambs, 11/16" at sill; 3/32" hinge and lock clearance at jambs.

installation_anchors.substrate: min. 18 ga. steel (33 ksi) / aluminum 1/8" min. 6063-T5
installation_anchors.min_embedment: three (3) threads min. penetration beyond metal face

installation_anchors.substrate: masonry: CMU per ASTM C90, min. 2000 psi

rules.governing: Single design rating table: +65/-65 psf at the tabulated overall frame sizes (sheet 1).
rules.separate_framing: Storefront / curtain wall framing around the door is under a separate approval; the lesser allowable pressure of the door and the framing controls the overall assembly. (sheet 3 elevations: doors inside IR-521, IR-500/501 and 1600 System 1 are under separate approval).
rules.water: Not approved where water infiltration resistance is required, unless installed only at locations covered by an overhang with overhang ratio >= 1:1 per FBC. (sheet 1)
notes: Max shim space 3/8" (1/4" at 1600 curtain wall jamb, section D/10).
Corner construction per sheet 1 (storefront and standard corner & frame end construction).
One installation anchor at each anchor location shown unless otherwise stated.
Install anchors within +/-1.000" of the depicted location and spacing (not cumulative).
Shim with load-bearing high-density plastic shims where the gap is 1/16" or more; max shim stack 3/8".
Embedment and edge distance exclude wall finishes (stucco, foam, brick veneer, siding).
Anchors and hardware corrosion resistant or coated.
Optional 1x wood buck at masonry/concrete if min. embedment and edge distance are still met in the host substrate.
Hollow / grout-filled block: no anchors in mortar joints; edge distance from free edge of block or mortar joint.
Install per anchor manufacturer's instructions; not in substrates weaker than the manufacturer's minimum.
